lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a staggered grid pattern with the highest intensity clusters located in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible intersecting with the primary spot rows, creating a faint rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible running longitudinally along the upper flank, characterized by a highlight on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, indicating significant tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Several small, dark fusiform silhouettes are visible in the sub-ventral water column, consistent with the presence of commensal organisms.
